per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: OpenAI Python SDK (pip install -U openai) with base_url="https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1", Anthropic Python SDK with base_url="https://api.xiaomimimo.com/anthropic", or curl against POST https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1/chat/completions with the api-key header.
chaining: mainland and overseas accounts have separate base URLs and keys, so usage and credit do not aggregate across regions

free_tier.stated: One-time free credits for all new and existing users, collected on the console Balance page, announced with the start of billing. No vendor page read states the amount of this credit. The promotions FAQ states that bonus credit from new user registration or Refer & Earn is currently valid for 40 days; the expiry of the January 2026 one-time credit itself is not stated. Calls deduct the complimentary free quota first and then the recharged balance, and an account with insufficient balance cannot use the API

limits.value: unverified: no vendor page read states the amount of the one-time free credit or the expiry of the January 2026 grant (one news site reports a figure received by one user); after the credit is used the account needs a recharged balance

binding_note: the one-time credit is the only free allowance and its size is unpublished on the page read

identity_cost.detail: overseas users register a Xiaomi account by email or by Google or Facebook sign-in; mainland users by mobile number or third-party sign-in. Real-name authentication applies to mainland users before recharging or buying a package, and overseas users recharge without it

reliability_note: an automatic keyword-based protection mechanism can block an account as abnormal usage until the vendor reviews it on request
confidence_note: the endpoint, routes, method and auth scheme are documented on first-party pages and confirmed by keyless probes on 2026-11-18; the probe raises confidence in endpoint liveness only, not in the credit amount or the key value.

notes: overseas first-recharge bonus: USD 0.72 once per account on a first top-up of any amount, valid 40 days; it needs a payment so it is not a card-free credit. The first-party inference endpoint is https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1 (OpenAI) and https://api.xiaomimimo.com/anthropic (Anthropic), confirmed by keyless probes on 2026-11-18; Token Plan and Batch use separate purchase-gated base URLs; the endpoint finding does not change the free-credit verdict. On 2026-11-18 two keyless POSTs returned HTTP 401 Invalid API Key, so the OpenAI-compatible route is live.
interface_detail: The platform is served by the first-party Xiaomi MiMo inference API, compatible with OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages formats; chat at POST https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1/chat/completions, models at GET https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1/models, Anthropic messages at POST https://api.xiaomimimo.com/anthropic/v1/messages; auth is api-key: $MIMO_API_KEY or Authorization: Bearer $MIMO_API_KEY, with a pay-as-you-go key of format sk-xxxxx created on the Console - API Keys page after sign-in. Token Plan uses token-plan-cn.xiaomimimo.com/v1 and Batch Inference uses batch-api-cn.xiaomimimo.com/v1, and regional base URLs and keys are not interoperable.
